reference_definition: delta = mean(channel | source finger at position P, idle capture) - mean(channel | source finger at P=0), computed within the SAME single-finger sweep (see record_crosstalk.py) -- the affected finger and the other 2 non-source fingers were held at the reference (0%, open) position throughout, idle, no contact.
additive_assumption: Total predicted baseline shift for finger F, given multiple other fingers moving simultaneously, is the SUM of each finger-pair's fitted function evaluated independently. NOT validated against real simultaneous-movement data -- every recording used to fit this model moved exactly one finger at a time. See crosstalk_model_report.md's per-pair 'significant' flag and README.md for where this assumption is least safe.
